authority: deterministic OHLC matching (Days 2/4/5 matchers) for all outcomes; ai_review fail-closed validator for all machine outputs
not_trade_gates_notice: Every rule is a review-only scoring predicate/feature for a shadow candidate detector. No rule is an execution gate. No output is or implies an executable action.
evidence_base: winner_loss_comparison_v1.json — 33 matched trades (20 VERIFIED_WIN / 6 losses / 7 partials); loss sample n=6; all adoptions provisional pending >=15 forward-captured trades (Day-6 thresholds)

rules.attempt_number_definition: 1 + count of prior entry announcements for the same campaign (same/near-identical zone or explicit re-enter reference) on the same trading day
rules.evidence: breach removed verified SL loss J17 (attempt 5) + 2 scratches; cost = winner J29 (~150p) under the stricter cap
removed all 3 re-entry losses (J08, J10, J17; ~450-700p avoided) at cost of 3 winners (J14, J19, J29; ~380p TP1-centric)
removed losses J03 + J17 and 1 scratch; cost = 1 small winner (J06, ~53p)

rules.predicate: claim_discounted_pips = min(claimed_pips, achievable_pips); inflation_ratio = claimed_pips / max(achievable_pips, 1); expectancy computed ONLY on TP1/TP2 structure + scratch modelling
rules.applies_to: result review + expectancy math, NOT entry scoring
rules.evidence: documented inflation: J30 +33-56% (material), S1 +8% (mild), J11 fill-dependent

rules.note: outcome-side diagnostic only; W median 70p vs L median 284p; NOT knowable at entry time — used for replay diagnostics, expectancy modelling, forward drift monitoring

rules.predicate: REJECTED as retrospectively defined (zone untraded 4h prior): 0/20 winners qualify because zones are posted at/after price arrival
rules.path_to_adoption: forward pre-marked levels (TV alert lane) enable a genuine freshness test

rules.predicate: 50p-from-zone-mid within 60min — zero discrimination (20/20 W and 5/5 L pass; median 0 min)
rules.possible_retest: from fill levels with a follower-fill model, not zone mid

rules.predicate: counter-trend veto — 1-1 on this sample (S2 lost; Jun-26 counter-trend campaign WON at half size); a veto removes winner J29
rules.note: recorded as a flag with weight 0; Farouk's own control is size reduction, which is out of scope (no risk sizing) — flag only

outcome_status_enum_source: deterministic matcher ONLY: VERIFIED_WIN | VERIFIED_LOSS | PARTIAL | CONTRADICTED | AMBIGUOUS_INTRABAR | INSUFFICIENT_DATA

baseline_candidate.definition: parsed setup with direction + numeric zone + SL passing deterministic evidence validators
baseline_candidate.label: WATCH

claim_quality_flags.inflation_ratio_gt_1.25_in_poster_window: claim_quality=DEGRADED (routes to human review; does not alter entry score)

label_mapping.override: HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED on any contradiction, ambiguity, missing required field, or DEGRADED claim quality

caps: no label above SHADOW_CANDIDATE_MEDIUM exists in v0.1
nothing skips the existing human-review queue
labels expire when the entry window passes (no retro-labels presented as live)

enforcement: ai_review.schema.validate_reviewer_output rejects any record whose keys match FORBIDDEN_KEY_SUBSTRINGS and stamps review_only=True, executable=False, trade_ready=False on acceptance; the stamp comes from the validator, never the producer
